_comment: Жёсткие правила, которые код соблюдает всегда. Составлено по литературному обзору 'Поиск научных статей: программный доступ' (10.11.2026). Числа лимитов нужно сверять с официальными страницами сервисов.

forbidden_sources.google_scholar: Официального API нет; автоматические запросы запрещены условиями, результат — CAPTCHA и бан IP.
forbidden_sources.elibrary: Открытого поискового API не найдено; автоматизация HTML не реализуется.
forbidden_sources.cyberleninka: Документированного API нет; автоматизация HTML не реализуется.
forbidden_sources.base: API только для зарегистрированных заранее IP/User-Agent.
forbidden_sources.scopus: Нужны подписка и ключ Elsevier; в этот инструмент не входит.
forbidden_sources.web_of_science: Нужна платная лицензия; в этот инструмент не входит.
forbidden_sources.ieee: Платный/ограниченный доступ; в этот инструмент не входит.
forbidden_sources.pmc_website: Сайт PMC (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles) для программ закрыт: массовая загрузка запрещена, нужны официальные каналы — E-utilities (поиск, db=pmc), OA Web Service и FTP по https (PDF/пакеты Open Access Subset), Europe PMC REST.

rules: Use only official APIs; never scrape HTML result pages.
Never bypass CAPTCHA, rotate IPs, or fake the User-Agent.
A 403/401 response means STOP for that host: do not retry.
arXiv: at most one request per 3 seconds, a single connection; automated access only through export.arxiv.org.

PMC main site (pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles) is never accessed. PMC is used only through official channels: E-utilities (db=pmc) for search, the PMC OA Web Service (oa.fcgi) with ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov over https for Open Access Subset PDFs, Europe PMC REST for XML, Unpaywall links.
OpenAlex needs a free API key (since 2026-02-13). Crossref needs a mailto (polite pool).
Full texts are downloaded only from legal open-access locations (Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, CORE, arXiv, Semantic Scholar openAccessPdf). Shadow libraries are never used.
Google Scholar, eLIBRARY.RU, CyberLeninka, BASE are NOT available to this agent.

pubmed.about: Biomedicine and life sciences: PubMed (MEDLINE, MeSH; abstracts) plus the PMC full-text archive (db=pmc), both searched with one query. PDFs of the PMC Open Access Subset are downloadable.
pubmed.hint: Field tags in brackets: [tiab] title/abstract, [ti], [au], [mh] MeSH, [pt] publication type, [dp] date. Wrong tags are silently ignored; always check querytranslation. New papers lack MeSH, so combine [mh] with [tiab].

europepmc.about: Life sciences: PubMed + PMC + preprints (bioRxiv, medRxiv) + patents. Searches full text of open articles. Good source of legal full-text XML.
europepmc.hint: Lucene-like: TITLE:"x", ABSTRACT:"x", PUB_YEAR:[2020 TO 2026], OPEN_ACCESS:y, HAS_FT:y. Synonym expansion is on by default.

arxiv.about: Preprints: physics, mathematics, computer science, q-bio, q-fin, statistics, eess, economics.
arxiv.hint: Prefixes ti:, abs:, au:, cat:, all:; operators AND, OR, ANDNOT; submittedDate:[YYYYMMDDHHMM TO YYYYMMDDHHMM]. Errors can arrive as an Atom entry, not as an HTTP code. English keywords only.

openalex.about: All sciences; open catalog of works, authors, institutions. Needs a free API key. Good general-purpose first source.
openalex.hint: search= supports AND/OR/NOT in uppercase and quotes; filters: publication_year, is_oa, type. Abstracts are inverted indexes.

crossref.about: DOI metadata for ~180M records; licenses, funders, references. Abstracts often missing. No boolean operators.
crossref.hint: query= is plain relevance search (no boolean). Filters: from-pub-date, until-pub-date, type:journal-article, has-abstract:true. Always send mailto.

semanticscholar.about: All sciences, strongest in computer science / AI; citation counts; links to open-access PDFs.
semanticscholar.hint: Relevance search is plain keywords (no boolean), depth limited to ~1000 results. Without an API key the shared pool often returns 429.

core.about: Aggregator of open-access repositories, full texts (needs a free API key).
core.hint: q= supports AND/OR and field filters such as yearPublished>=2020. Search endpoints need a trailing slash.

doaj.about: Curated directory of peer-reviewed open-access journals and their articles.
doaj.hint: Elasticsearch query_string over bibjson.title, bibjson.abstract, bibjson.year. 2 requests per second.
